html:
The sovereign wealth fund of Qatar, founded in 2005 to invest the country's gas revenue around the world. It manages assets worth several hundred billion dollars.

Qatar is small but sits on part of the largest natural gas field in the world, which it shares with Iran. From the late 1990s it shipped liquefied gas around the world and grew very rich. A sovereign wealth fund is a state-owned investment fund. Its purpose is to turn wealth from a resource that will run out into lasting income for future generations.

The fund became known for trophy buys, especially in London: the Harrods store, a large share of Canary Wharf, the Shard tower. During the financial crisis of 2008 it put money into Barclays and other Western firms. Through a subsidiary it bought the football club Paris Saint-Germain in 2011. It also holds stakes in carmakers, banks and the Istanbul stock exchange.

Its investments gave Qatar influence far beyond its size, alongside Al Jazeera and the 2022 World Cup. Critics note that its decisions are not open to public view.
sum: The sovereign wealth fund of Qatar, founded in 2005 to invest the country's gas revenue around the world. It manages assets worth several hundred billion dollars.
